description: This Java class defines a custom UI component 'LogTextBox' extending Android's TextView. It is an editable, scrollable text box designed for logging purposes within an Android app, mimicking an EditText with scrolling capabilities but without a cursor.

classes.description: A custom TextView that is editable and scrollable, intended for logging or output display within Android applications.
